question: Does the schema-8 observation-order migration provide acceptable upgrade semantics for existing schema-6/7 portable stores and all derived consumers?
rationale: The branch changes stored ordering identity and canonical selection across multiple consumers; tests strongly support the design, but only the repository owners can accept the upgrade contract and release risk.

options.title: Approve after upgrade proof
options.body: Require a representative legacy-store upgrade/read-only transcript and overlapping-sync runtime evidence, remove the contributor changelog edit, then approve the persistent ordering contract.

options.title: Keep the draft for narrowing
options.body: Hold the PR as a draft if final review finds any consumer or migration path that cannot safely adopt the same ordering invariant.

recommendation.title: Approve after upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Require a representative legacy-store upgrade/read-only transcript and overlapping-sync runtime evidence, remove the contributor changelog edit, then approve the persistent ordering contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The release baseline and original store/sync ownership make this the best available owner for accepting schema and upgrade risk.
